items.title: From near oblivion to Europe - Brighton celebrate 125th anniversary in style
items.excerpt: From obscurity and near oblivion to Premier League and Europe - Brighton celebrate their 125th anniversary.

items.title: No revival in sight for 'fragile' Spurs after Villa defeat
items.excerpt: Tottenham look no closer to solving their problems as they slip to a home defeat by Aston Villa to add to their Premier League misery.

items.title: Ratcliffe 'must go' says Man Utd Muslim fan group
items.excerpt: The Manchester United Muslim Supporters Club says United co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe "must go" after he spoke out against immigration and said the country was "on the slide".

items.title: Castellanos spitting claim overshadows West Ham's show of character
items.excerpt: Millwall keeper Filip Marshcall alleges he was spat at by West Ham forward Taty Castellanos during their 2-2 draw.

items.title: Suzuki proves worthy replacement for Martinez at Villa
items.excerpt: Aston Villa new boy Zion Suzuki deserves as much credit as anyone for their first Premier League win of the season at struggling Tottenham.

items.title: Clark resigns as Hartlepool boss in post-match interview
items.excerpt: Lee Clark resigns as Hartlepool United head coach after a sixth loss in seven games following the 3-1 home defeat by Worthing.

items.title: Lowly Peterborough sack manager Williams
items.excerpt: Peterborough United sack manager Luke Williams after Saturday's defeat at home by Doncaster leaves them second from bottom in League One.

items.title: 'It's a big lesson to learn' - Arteta on 'painful' Brighton defeat
items.excerpt: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says Arsenal were "very far" from the standards required to compete after the Gunners lost 3-0 to Brighton - their first defeat in the Premier League this season.

items.title: Malard scores on debut as Chelsea beat Birmingham
items.excerpt: Melvine Malard scores on her WSL debut for Chelsea as the Blues run out as comfortable winners against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge.

items.title: 'Stay humble' - Hurzeler's plea to Brighton after huge Arsenal win
items.excerpt: Brighton manager Fabian Hurzeler highlights his team's intensity, togetherness and squad depth following their resounding 3-0 win against Arsenal in the Premier League.

items.title: Tottenham need 'blood & fight' not just to play better - de Zerbi
items.excerpt: Spurs head coach Roberto de Zerbi says his side "have to be stronger" following their loss against Aston Villa in the Premier League, focusing on the squad's "behaviour" rather than their quality.

items.title: Goodwin double helps London City win at struggling Charlton
items.excerpt: London City Lionesses earn their first away win of the season, with Isobel Goodwin scoring twice, as they emphatically beat a struggling Charlton side who have now lost all three of their WSL games.
